description: This PHP class defines the VacancyAttachment entity for the OrangeHRM system, representing attachments related to job vacancies with properties such as filename, file type, size, content, and associated vacancy.

classes.name: VacancyAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a vacancy attachment with properties for file details, associated vacancy, and metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the attachment.
